As Abbvie (ABBV) Share Price Declined, Shareholder Van Hulzen Asset Management Lowered Its Stake; Pacwest Bancorp Del Com (PACW) Share Value Declined While Ipg Investment Advisors Boosted Holding 
April 24, 2018 - By Peter Erickson 
Van Hulzen Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Abbvie Inc (ABBV) by 62.13% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Van Hulzen Asset Management Llc sold 35,461 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.31% with the market. The institutional investor held 21,616 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.09 million, down from 57,077 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Van Hulzen Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Abbvie Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $144.18B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.47% or $2.2999 during the last trading session, reaching $90.8701. About 2.64 million shares traded. AbbVie Inc. (NYSE:ABBV) has risen 39.20% since April 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 27.65% the S&P500.

PacWest Bancorp (NASDAQ:PACW) has declined 4.60% since April 24, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 16.15% the S&P500.

On Friday, February 2 the stock rating was maintained by Argus Research with “Buy”. BMO Capital Markets maintained the shares of ABBV in report on Wednesday, October 11 with “Hold” rating. It also increased its holding in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2,010 shares in the quarter, for a total of 108,522 shares, and has risen its stake in Occidental Petroleum (NYSE:OXY). 
Analysts await AbbVie Inc. (NYSE:ABBV) to report earnings on April, 26 before the open. They expect $1.78 EPS, up 39.06% or $0.50 from last year’s $1.28 per share. ABBV’s profit will be $2.82B for 12.76 P/E if the $1.78 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.48 actual EPS reported by AbbVie Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 20.27% EPS growth.
